title: Data Pipeline Dead-Letter Queue & Exponential Retry
description: Build a robust retry wrapper for asynchronous event streaming that routes failed payloads to a DLQ.
derived_requirements: Calculate exponential backoff with randomized jitter
Attach original error stack trace and attempt count to DLQ payload
Alert telemetry on persistent DLQ ingestion spikes

required_behavior: Execute maximum 5 attempts with increasing delays
Publish exact original payload to dead_letter_queue topic
forbidden_behavior: Infinite retry loops blocking the consumer thread

failure_taxonomy.description: Corrupted event payload dropped without dead-letter audit record.

ground_truth_rationale: Streaming data pipelines must preserve data completeness and prevent thread blocking.
